title: CONTEMPORARY AND AFRICAN DANCE NOTATION a
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the periods of sound in a song, and rests represent the lengths of the silences in a piece of music."
Notes are the periods of sound in a song, and rests represent the lengths of the silences in a piece of music.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to show relations in space."
The relationship pins are used to show relations in space.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to notate the dimension and quality of movement."
Additional symbols are used to notate the dimension and quality of movement.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the preservation of classical dance documentation."
The primary use of Dance Notations is the preservation of classical dance documentation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to represent the location of a hand or foot that passes through the coronal plane which extends from the sides of the body."
A short horizontal line is used to represent the location of a hand or foot that passes through the coronal plane which extends from the sides of the body.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a segment of music that sounds complete in and of itself, often only a few measures long.[3] Practice listening to natural phrasing in music."
A musical phrase is a segment of music that sounds complete in and of itself, often only a few measures long.[3] Practice listening to natural phrasing in music.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a subcategory of a genre of dance."
A dance form is a subcategory of a genre of dance.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any human movement included in the act of dancing - it can include dance steps, facial movements, , gestures, and even everyday movements such as walking."
Action is any human movement included in the act of dancing - it can include dance steps, facial movements, , gestures, and even everyday movements such as walking.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an enjoyable way to be more physically active and stay fit."
Dancing is an enjoyable way to be more physically active and stay fit.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the conduit between the inner realm of intentions, ideas, emotions and identity and the outer realm of expression and communication."
The body is the conduit between the inner realm of intentions, ideas, emotions and identity and the outer realm of expression and communication.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the recording of dance movement through the use of written symbols."
Dance notation is the recording of dance movement through the use of written symbols.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a structured system for analysing and recording of movements with symbols."
Lebanotation is a structured system for analysing and recording of movements with symbols.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a conduit of expression and communication-the message and the medium."
Dance as an art is a conduit of expression and communication-the message and the medium.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a series or system of using symbols or signs as a form of communication."
Notation is a series or system of using symbols or signs as a form of communication.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a dance notation system that was invented by Iver Cooper."
Action Stroke Dance Notation (ASDN) is a dance notation system that was invented by Iver Cooper.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a country with a lot of tribes - each of them varying in culture and tradition."
Nigeria is a country with a lot of tribes - each of them varying in culture and tradition.
fib: ______ is the best way to count the beats.
Listening to the drum line
Listening to the drum line is the best way to count the beats.
______ are the main tools for allowing you to push away from the standing leg while creating a grounded look that pushes down into the floor to keep you stable.
calves
The calves are the main tools for allowing you to push away from the standing leg while creating a grounded look that pushes down into the floor to keep you stable.
______ are used when dancing with a partner and how to train them for the work they have to do help make your dancing look effortless and with better technique.
Understanding which muscles
Understanding which muscles are used when dancing with a partner and how to train them for the work they have to do help make your dancing look effortless and with better technique.
______ are the dancer's main action tools so when these are strong you have more power and better leg action potential in your dancing.
legs
The legs are the dancer's main action tools so when these are strong you have more power and better leg action potential in your dancing.
______ is used to record the energy content of a motion.
Effort- Shape Description
Effort- Shape Description is used to record the energy content of a motion.
______ are a great way to strengthen the IT Band and Vastus.
Side Lunges
Side Lunges are a great way to strengthen the IT Band and Vastus.
______ is a way to read and write any kind of dance movement.
Dance Writing
Dance Writing is a way to read and write any kind of dance movement.
______ is made up of streams of movement and pauses and movement of relative stillness.
Dance
Dance is made up of streams of movement and pauses and movement of relative stillness.
______ is a kind of written critique that is aimed at evaluating the techniques, atmosphere and aesthetics of concert dance.
Dance performance review
Dance performance review is a kind of written critique that is aimed at evaluating the techniques, atmosphere and aesthetics of concert dance.
______ is a class or category of art or dance based on a set of stylistic criteria.
dance genre
A dance genre is a class or category of art or dance based on a set of stylistic criteria.
______ is a kind of simplified "Structural Description" - you only write down what you think of as important.
Motif Description
Motif Description is a kind of simplified "Structural Description" - you only write down what you think of as important.
______ is the study of human dance movement.
Dance kinesiology
Dance kinesiology is the study of human dance movement.
______ are used only for specific dance forms.
Several notation systems
Several notation systems are used only for specific dance forms.
______ is the regular pattern of beats in a song and how those beats are stressed.
Meter
Meter is the regular pattern of beats in a song and how those beats are stressed.
______ are the foundational concepts and vocabulary that help students develop movement skills and understand dance either as artist or scientist.
elements of dance
The elements of dance are the foundational concepts and vocabulary that help students develop movement skills and understand dance either as artist or scientist.
